question: Will Shohei Ohtani hit at least 43 home runs in 2026?
resolution_criteria:
Resolves to YES is Shohei Ohtani hits 43 home runs in 2026 during the regular season. Otherwise resolves to NO

The MLB regular season will end on September 27, 2026.
research:
I couldn't open any primary pages because the proxy refused every fetch. Everything below comes from search-result summaries, so the exact totals should be checked against MLB.com or Baseball-Reference. Some search results were dated after 2026-09-12 and I ignored them, as instructed.

## 1. Resolution source
- No URL is given in the criteria. In practice the answer comes from Ohtani's official 2026 regular-season home run total, from MLB.com, ESPN or Baseball-Reference. I couldn't load his MLB.com stats page or ESPN game log to check the figure as of 2026-09-12. [ESPN game log](https://www.espn.com/mlb/player/gamelog/_/id/39832/shohei-ohtani)

## 2. Current status
- 2026-08-18: Ohtani hit his 30th home run of 2026, a 448-foot two-run shot off Ryan Feltner at Coors Field in a 7-6 win over the Rockies. It was his sixth straight 30-homer season. He had homered twice the night before. [MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/dodgers/news/shohei-ohtani-hits-30th-home-run-of-season-vs-rockies), [AP via News4Jax](https://www.news4jax.com/sports/2026/08/19/ohtani-reaches-30-hrs-for-6th-straight-season-as-dodgers-beat-rockies-7-6/)
- 2026-09-09/10: The Dodgers put him on the 15-day injured list with right biceps and left knee problems, backdated to Sept. 9. He had missed six of the previous seven games. A Korean report gave his earliest return as Sept. 24. [Nippon.com/Jiji](https://www.nippon.com/en/news/yjj2026091000734/), [MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/dodgers/news/shohei-ohtani-out-of-lineup-again-vs-reds), [Herald Corp](https://biz.heraldcorp.com/article/10871173)
- I couldn't confirm his exact total on 2026-09-12 from a source dated before the cutoff. It was 30 on Aug. 18, and I found no report before the cutoff of another home run after that.
- **What it means:** to reach 43 he would need about 13 more home runs. If he returns on Sept. 24 at the earliest, only about four games are left before the season ends on Sept. 27. That makes the question effectively settled, though I couldn't confirm his exact total on 2026-09-12.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- About 2026-09-10: The Dodgers announced the IL move after being swept by the Reds. Manager Dave Roberts called it "the right thing to do" so Ohtani can recover for the postseason. [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/sports/mlb/dodgers-announce-bad-shohei-ohtani-news-following-reds-sweep-12423999), [Adnkronos](https://english.adnkronos.com/2026/09/10/dodgers-star-ohtani-to-go-on-injured-list/)
- About 2026-09-05: He sat out a third straight game with left knee and right biceps discomfort. [La Nacion/AP](https://www.lanacion.com.ar/usa/ohtani-out-of-dodgers-lineup-for-3rd-straight-day-dealing-with-left-knee-right-biceps-discomfort-nid05092026/)
- Early September: another report said he was also dealing with neck soreness. [Medicine Hat News/AP](https://medicinehatnews.com/?p=5243003)
- Background: he had not pitched since July 3, when he left a start with left knee discomfort and right biceps soreness.

## 4. Base rates
- His recent full-season totals: 44 HR in 2023, 54 in 2024 and 55 in 2025. [MLB.com](https://www.mlb.com/news/shohei-ohtani-career-dodgers-home-run-record-2025)
- His 2026 pace was slower: 30 HR through about 121 games by Aug. 18, roughly 0.25 per game.
- Hitting 13 home runs in about four games has never happened in MLB. The single-game record is 4 HR. Even at his best pace (about 0.34 HR per game in 2025), he would average about 1.4 home runs in four games.

## 5. Other forecasts
- I found no Polymarket, Kalshi or Manifold market on "Ohtani 43+ HR in 2026."
- 2026-05-09: Kalshi's "Ohtani leads MLB in home runs" contract was trading around 6¢. [SimpleFunctions/Kalshi](https://simplefunctions.dev/api/public/market/KXLEADERMLBHR-26-SOHT?depth=true)
- Before the season, FanGraphs Depth Charts projected 48 HR for Ohtani, the most in MLB. [AOL](https://www.aol.com/sports/dodgers-superstar-shohei-ohtani-predicted-044903411.html)

## 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-09-24 (earliest): possible return from the IL, depending on how his biceps and knee recover. [Herald Corp](https://biz.heraldcorp.com/article/10871173)
- 2026-09-27: last day of the regular season. Postseason home runs don't count.
- The Dodgers could also keep him out longer to protect him for the playoffs, which would leave even fewer games.
